headline: Trump says Russian "small" projectiles fell in Poland by mistake
summary: US President Donald Trump said Russian missiles that landed at several points in Poland over recent hours did so by mistake, calling two of them small.
why: Poland is a NATO member bordering Ukraine and Russia, so missile incidents on its territory affect European security, defence spending and regional risk premiums.
original_headline: Trump afirma que los "pequeños" proyectiles rusos cayeron en Polonia por error
